title: DERELAB: Probing Defeasible Reasoning and Confirmation Bias in LLMs with a Generative Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.30413v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Defeasible reasoning is a type of reasoning where inferences are drawn from plausible current evidence, but can be retracted upon the introduction of newer evidence. Although recent studies have examined language-model behaviors in defeasible reasoning, the datasets have been static and lack wide coverage of non-monotonic reasoning categories. We introduce DeReLab, a generative framework that produces multi-turn belief-updating conversations from parameterized graph structures across default and inheritance reasoning, with formally verified ground truth at every turn, enabling controlled measurement of how models respond to confirming and disconfirming evidence. This controlled generation process creates a testbed for experimental designs that isolate specific reasoning demands. translated_title: DERELAB：基于生成式基准探测大语言模型中的可废止推理与确认偏差
translated_abstract: 可废止推理是一种推理类型，即推论是基于当前合理的证据得出的，但在引入新证据时可以被撤回。尽管近期已有研究考察了语言模型在可废止推理中的行为，但现有数据集是静态的，且缺乏对非单调推理类别的广泛覆盖。我们提出了DeReLab，这是一个生成式框架，它从参数化图结构中生成多轮信念更新对话，涵盖默认推理和继承推理，并在每一轮都提供经过形式化验证的真值，从而能够对模型如何响应支持性与反驳性证据进行受控测量。这一受控生成过程为隔离特定推理需求的实验设计创建了一个测试平台。将该能力应用于确认偏差的研究中，我们评估了九个开源和专有大语言模型，发现几乎所有模型都表现出系统性……
tldr: 该论文提出生成式基准DeReLab，通过参数化图结构生成带有形式化验证真值的多轮信念更新对话，实现对大语言模型可废止推理能力的受控评估，并发现几乎所有被评估的模型都表现出确认偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DeReLab, a generative benchmark that produces multi-turn belief-updating conversations with formally verified ground truths from parameterized graph structures, enabling controlled evaluation of LLMs' defeasible reasoning and revealing that nearly all evaluated models exhibit confirmation bias.
